These compounds all have a shared target of the High affinity cationic amino acid transporter 1. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, with varying degrees of support from different pathways. The evidence suggests a possible role for Zeylanol in regulating the transporter, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated. The relationship is supported by multiple independent pathways, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct effect of Zeylanol on the transporter.
